name: ui-ux
summary: Patch 1.25.2: completed the motion-duration reconciliation 1.25.0 left half-done, and repaired the axis-catalog pointer. design-system-architect — the agent that actually writes the token layer into a project — still emitted `fast: 100ms` / `normal: 200ms` / `slow: 300ms`, disagreeing with motion.md's canonical `fast 150 / base 250 / slow 400` on all three values and naming the middle token `normal` where seven other files use `base`; it now emits the canonical scale and names motion.md § The duration scale as its owner. design-system-guardian mapped `transition: 200ms ease` to `duration-fast`, but 200ms is motion.md's *base* band — corrected to `duration-base`. Both fallbacks moved with their sources. The pack now holds zero duration values and zero duration-token names that disagree with motion.md. Separately, ui-principles.md § Axis catalog pointed at the axis depth as `[...](../ai-patterns/axis-catalog.md)`, a link that resolves only inside the template repo: phase-4.2-apply.md copies rules to `.claude/rules/` and ai-patterns to `ai/patterns/`, so after install that href resolves to `.claude/ai-patterns/axis-catalog.md`, which never exists. Replaced with the bare `ai/patterns/axis-catalog.md` path the pack's six other pointers already use — it was the only route to the 7,828 chars of axis depth this release moved out of the always-loaded rule. Patch 1.25.1: deleted _examples/ui-principles.md (97% copy of its source) and self-fallbacked the ui-principles topic at rules/ui-principles.md — the abridgement dropped `severity: must` and `applies-to:` and demoted five Should imperatives to noun phrases, so greenfield (the only path that reads a fallback) received the pack's one always-loaded rule with no severity binding. Matches mobile 1.9.0, which deleted the identical 96% copy. Batch-2 pass over commands/ + skills/ + ai-patterns/. Ten commands made self-disambiguating: the routing map promoted out of one command's Related section to a reachable top-level map listing all ten, a Not-this-command ANTI-trigger block on every command, and the /redesign-vs-/art-direct split resolved by a mechanical LANGUAGE-OR-COMPOSITION TEST run from the render + token source instead of asked of the user. Corrections: WCAG 2.5.8 (AA, 24x24) named as the target-size floor with 2.5.5 (AAA, 44x44) as the house target; 2.3.3 corrected to Level AAA with 2.2.2 (Level A) named; a fabricated npm package, a discontinued pub package, an unpublished eslint plugin, a removed RN profiler, a renamed animation library and a non-existent /perf-check all removed; four of six contradictory motion durations reconciled into one table owned by motion.md (the remaining two, in design-system-architect and design-system-guardian, are fixed at 1.25.2); contain:paint, the global reduced-motion reset and filter-is-GPU-cheap caveated or corrected. /enhance-ui no longer hard-halts without a render harness.
